summary: preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes bundled 727KB obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. On `npm install`, setup.mjs downloads a Bun binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a single-line 727KB obfuscated bundle (string-array rotation via a WV8StW routine, numeric/string constant tables, scrambled short identifiers) that is not referenced by the package's declared main (index.js) or any documented entry point — its sole invocation site is the preinstall step, executed by the freshly-fetched Bun runtime rather than by Node. Package.json metadata is placeholder (name `example-js-project`, empty description, empty author, no repository or homepage), and the declared runtime dependencies (`vue`, `vue-class-component`) are unrelated to the preinstall behavior. The alternate-runtime dropper pattern routes execution of the obfuscated payload through a non-Node interpreter fetched at install time, so the contents of math_init.js run on the installer's machine with the installer's privileges without inspection by Node-based tooling.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
